answer: Continuous Activity Decay Pricing. Each identity accrues a visible trust balance from sustained, verified interactions; new identities start near zero. Platforms charge resource access inversely to that balance, so a fresh account pays a steep per-call premium while aged ones pay little. An attacker must harbor thousands of identities through months of paid activity before their costs fall. Detection of a raven cluster triggers a jade-tier surcharge on all linked accounts, multiplying the attacker's spend per useful identity.
